en.answer: You take no battle damage, and your opponent takes 2000 points of battle damage.
en.question: The effect of my <<12957>> has previously resolved this turn. If my <<12862>> (ATK 0) now attacks my opponent's attack position monster (ATK 2000), what happens to the battle damage?
en.title: If my <<12862>> attacks my opponent's monster, and the effect of <<12957>> is applying, what happens to the battle damage?

ja.answer: 自分はダメージを受けず、相手は２０００の戦闘ダメージを受けます。
